applies_to: Final reader review and corrected answers, separately from factual criteria.

completeness.0: Missing most questions or draft-review scope.
completeness.1: Useful coverage with identifiable unanswered questions, predicates or draft-review gaps.
completeness.2: All twelve corrected answers, material twenty-four-predicate conditions and supplied draft reviews covered.

organization.0: Findings or corrected answers cannot be located reliably.
organization.1: Content is usable with navigation or grouping gaps.
organization.2: Factual findings, draft distinctions, usability judgments and question-keyed corrected answers are easy to locate.

visible_qualifications.0: Material source status, uncertainty or evidence boundaries are absent.
visible_qualifications.1: Qualifications are present but important boundaries are detached or incomplete.
visible_qualifications.2: Draft/proposal status, conditions, historical scope and unknowns appear beside affected claims with source locators.

action_clarity.0: No supported correction or consequential next action.
action_clarity.1: Corrections exist but remaining decisions or evidence actions are unclear.
action_clarity.2: Supported corrections and consequential owner/evidence next actions are concrete, with unknown owners explicit.

limits: These scores measure the bounded reader artifacts only.
Factual failures remain separate and cannot be offset by these scores.
One matched pair supplies no general reliability or effort-savings estimate.
